# Raster

> A monochrome design system: paper, ink, gray, hairlines, and a 204px module. 74 React components as precompiled StyleX with one stylesheet, the same components as rs-* CSS, and a shadcn-compatible registry. Version 0.4.0.

Install with `npm install @noorddev/raster-react` and `import "@noorddev/raster-react/css"`, vendor the source with `npx @noorddev/raster-cli add <name>`, or use `npx shadcn add https://getraster.com/r/<name>.json`. Every component page below has install paths, a React example, a props table generated from the types, keyboard interactions, and accessibility notes.

## Docs

- [Guide](https://getraster.com/docs/guide.md): install, theming, cascade layers, StyleX, CSS, CLI, registry, and conventions for agents
- [Component index](https://getraster.com/docs/index.md): the catalogue by category
- [Tokens](https://getraster.com/docs/tokens.md): every custom property with light and dark values
- [Props JSON](https://getraster.com/docs/props.json): every export and its props as data
- [Registry index](https://getraster.com/r/index.json): the shadcn-compatible registry; items at https://getraster.com/r/<name>.json

## Actions

- [Button](https://getraster.com/docs/button.md): Solid ink primary and 1px ghost. 40px tall; 36px small.
- [Button group](https://getraster.com/docs/button-group.md): Joined ghost buttons with a 1px rule between.
- [Text link](https://getraster.com/docs/link.md): Text link with a hairline underline. In-copy variant is inset 1px.
- [Dropdown menu](https://getraster.com/docs/dropdown-menu.md): Action menu with menuitem roles and arrow-key movement.
- [Toggle](https://getraster.com/docs/toggle.md): Pressable control. Pressed fills ink. State is aria-pressed.
- [Toggle group](https://getraster.com/docs/toggle-group.md): Joined toggles, one pressed, 1px between.
- [Context menu](https://getraster.com/docs/context-menu.md): Menu at the pointer on right-click, or on Shift+F10 from the keyboard. Escape and outside click close it.
- [Menubar](https://getraster.com/docs/menubar.md): Row of dropdowns in a 1px strip.
- [Command](https://getraster.com/docs/command.md): Command palette in a native dialog. Filter, arrows, enter.
- [Theme toggle](https://getraster.com/docs/theme-toggle.md): Icon that swaps moon and sun with the color scheme. Saved in localStorage.

## Forms

- [Input](https://getraster.com/docs/input.md): Text field. 1px control border, 2px focus ring, 12px label above.
- [Label](https://getraster.com/docs/label.md): 12px secondary label, set above the control.
- [Field](https://getraster.com/docs/field.md): Label, control, and a hint or error stacked in one cell.
- [Input group](https://getraster.com/docs/input-group.md): Addon and field share a 1px border.
- [Native select](https://getraster.com/docs/native-select.md): Native select with Raster 1px chrome.
- [Radio](https://getraster.com/docs/radio.md): Single-choice control. Selected dot is ink.
- [Checkbox](https://getraster.com/docs/checkbox.md): Multi-choice. 16px box, 3px radius, ink fill when checked.
- [Switch](https://getraster.com/docs/switch.md): 32×18 control. On fills ink; off is a 1px track. The thumb moves; the box stays 32px.
- [Slider](https://getraster.com/docs/slider.md): 2px track, ink fill, 14px thumb on a 24px hit area.
- [Select](https://getraster.com/docs/select.md): Closed trigger with a chevron. The menu overlays the page.
- [Textarea](https://getraster.com/docs/textarea.md): Multiline field, vertical resize only.
- [One-time code](https://getraster.com/docs/input-otp.md): One cell per character. Auto-advance, backspace, and paste.
- [Combobox](https://getraster.com/docs/combobox.md): Text field with a filtered listbox.
- [Calendar](https://getraster.com/docs/calendar.md): Month grid. Selected day is ink; today is a 1px outline. Weeks start Monday.
- [Date picker](https://getraster.com/docs/date-picker.md): 1px trigger that opens a calendar overlay.
- [Form](https://getraster.com/docs/form.md): Stacked fields with one primary action at the end.

## Navigation

- [Tabs](https://getraster.com/docs/tabs.md): Text tabs in one row. Active tab has a 1px underline.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://getraster.com/docs/breadcrumbs.md): Ancestor links, 40% slashes, current page at full ink.
- [Crumb bar](https://getraster.com/docs/crumb-bar.md): Fixed 72px bar. Transparent at rest; scrolled state adds paper, a bottom 1px, and the trail.
- [Pagination](https://getraster.com/docs/pagination.md): Square page controls. Current page is solid ink.
- [Stepper](https://getraster.com/docs/stepper.md): Numbered dots joined by 1px lines. Done fills ink; active is outlined.
- [Navigation menu](https://getraster.com/docs/navigation-menu.md): Horizontal links. The current page is full ink.
- [Sidebar](https://getraster.com/docs/sidebar.md): 204-wide rail with a head, nav, and foot. 1px on all four sides.

## Feedback

- [Progress](https://getraster.com/docs/progress.md): 4px bar. Percentage is set in the label.
- [Badge](https://getraster.com/docs/badge.md): 11px badge. Outline, solid, and muted fills.
- [Alert](https://getraster.com/docs/alert.md): 1px frame with an icon. Solid ink variant for critical.
- [Skeleton](https://getraster.com/docs/skeleton.md): Divider-tone pulse. Animation stops when prefers-reduced-motion is on.
- [Empty](https://getraster.com/docs/empty.md): Placeholder cell with a title, a sentence, and an optional action.
- [Spinner](https://getraster.com/docs/spinner.md): 16px 1px ring. Animation stops when prefers-reduced-motion is on.
- [Tooltip](https://getraster.com/docs/tooltip.md): Label on hover and keyboard focus; a real element that describes its trigger.
- [Toast](https://getraster.com/docs/toast.md): Bottom-right status, aria-live polite. Stays four seconds or longer for longer text; pauses on hover; closes on demand.
- [Callout](https://getraster.com/docs/callout.md): Note in running copy. 1px hairline, radius 0. No left bar.

## Surfaces

- [Dialog](https://getraster.com/docs/dialog.md): Modal with a title, body, and two equal actions.
- [Card](https://getraster.com/docs/card.md): Typography stack: label, title, and body. No outline.
- [Alert dialog](https://getraster.com/docs/alert-dialog.md): Native dialog that must be answered. Escape and light dismiss are off.
- [Popover](https://getraster.com/docs/popover.md): Native Popover API. Top layer, light dismiss.
- [Sheet](https://getraster.com/docs/sheet.md): Native dialog docked to a screen edge, with the platform focus trap and backdrop.
- [Drawer](https://getraster.com/docs/drawer.md): Native dialog from the bottom edge, with the platform focus trap and backdrop.
- [Hover card](https://getraster.com/docs/hover-card.md): Preview panel on hover and keyboard focus.
- [Resizable](https://getraster.com/docs/resizable.md): Two panes split by a draggable 1px handle. Arrows move it; value is in ARIA.

## Content

- [Mono chip](https://getraster.com/docs/chip.md): Mono identifier with a 1px mixed border.
- [Table](https://getraster.com/docs/table.md): Open grid, 1px row rules, last column right-aligned. Total rows use 2px rules.
- [Accordion](https://getraster.com/docs/accordion.md): Native details rows on 1px rules. Shared name keeps one item open.
- [Avatar](https://getraster.com/docs/avatar.md): 32px circle of initials, or a covering image. Broken images fall back. Rows overlap 8px.
- [Item](https://getraster.com/docs/item.md): Flush row: title and description on the left, meta on the right.
- [Separator](https://getraster.com/docs/separator.md): 1px rule, horizontal or vertical.
- [Scroll area](https://getraster.com/docs/scroll-area.md): Overflow box with the scrollbar hidden and 20px feathers at the ends.
- [Collapsible](https://getraster.com/docs/collapsible.md): Native details disclosure.
- [Kbd](https://getraster.com/docs/kbd.md): Mono key cap with a 1px frame and a heavier bottom edge.
- [Carousel](https://getraster.com/docs/carousel.md): Scroll-snap track. Buttons nudge one slide; ends feather.
- [Data table](https://getraster.com/docs/data-table.md): Sortable table. Headers expose aria-sort.
- [Aspect ratio](https://getraster.com/docs/aspect-ratio.md): Box that holds a ratio. Media fills it.
- [References](https://getraster.com/docs/references.md): Inline citations, a numbered 1px list, and a cite box. Numerals hang in the gutter.

## Icons

- [Icons](https://getraster.com/docs/icons.md): 16 viewBox marks, 1px currentColor, butt/miter. Shipped in the React package.

## Charts

- [Charts](https://getraster.com/docs/chart.md): Line on a 204 field. 1px grid, ink marks. Series use solid, dashed, gray, or dotted. One optional spot color.
- [Bar chart](https://getraster.com/docs/bar-chart.md): Vertical or horizontal. Thin ink bars, square ends. Stacks when series share a field.
- [Area chart](https://getraster.com/docs/area-chart.md): Filled field under the first series. 1px grid, textured series, one optional spot color.
- [Scatter chart](https://getraster.com/docs/scatter-chart.md): Marks on a 1px grid. Ink, or one optional spot color.
- [Donut or share](https://getraster.com/docs/donut.md): Ring against its total, or a flush share strip. 1px stroke.
- [Histogram](https://getraster.com/docs/histogram.md): Histogram. Adjacent bins, 1px between.
- [Small multiples](https://getraster.com/docs/small-multiples.md): Repeated charts on the same axes. One 184 column per panel.

## Patterns

- [Inline form](https://getraster.com/docs/inline-form.md): One field with the submit action inside. The button appears after the input validates.
- [Workflow card](https://getraster.com/docs/workflow.md): Dashed 1px pipeline step. Drag handle, dashed chips, ghost add-step.
- [Assistant panel](https://getraster.com/docs/assistant.md): Chat panel: user block, reply, suggestion card, input row.
